name: sidebar
title: ui.sidebar
lead: Sets the sidebar for everyone in the room; lines run top to bottom and only changed lines are sent. nil or false removes the sidebar.
signature: ui.sidebar(opts: ({ title: Text ?, lines: { Text }? } | false)?)

usedIn.quote: ui.sidebar{ title = "INDIGO", lines = { "Chips  1200", "Bet  50", "", "Roulette" } }   -- everyone in the room
player.ui.sidebar{ title = "INDIGO", lines = { ... } }   -- one player; lines run top to bottom
player.ui.sidebar{ title = { "KART", color = "gold", bold = true }, lines = {
p.ui.sidebar { title = { "KART", effect = rainbow, bold = true } }
